---
title: Overview
description: Behavior and the contract live in core and vue.
kicker: Docs
---

`core` and `vue` hold the behavior and the contract. Components only read tokens.

- [Install](/docs/install): vendor the library into a project's `vendor/ui` with subtree, and commit it there.
- [Tokens](/docs/tokens): twelve variables, defined on `.ui`.
- [Components](/components): one page per folder in `src/components`, and one page per component inside it. The folder page shows the demos. The component page is the writeup.
